units.source_text: 父親已經不在了，他那可親而又可怕的存在一刻也沒有離開過我。

en.t: My father was gone, yet that dear and terrifying presence of his had never left me for even a moment.

units.source_text: 父親不在了，我覺得自己苦惱的罈子頓時變得空空蕩蕩。

en.t: With my father gone, I felt as though the jar of my suffering had suddenly become completely empty.

units.source_text: 我甚至還在心裡想，自己苦惱的罈子之所以如此沉重，也都是因為父親的緣故嗎？

en.t: I even wondered inwardly whether the reason the jar of my suffering had been so heavy was all because of my father.

units.source_text: 我像洩了氣的氣球，甚至喪失了苦惱的能力。

en.t: I was like a deflated balloon, and I even lost the ability to suffer.

units.source_text: 大哥完全履行了他對我的承諾。

en.t: My eldest brother fully carried out the promise he had made to me.

units.source_text: 從我生長的小鎮坐四五個小時的火車南下，

en.t: Going south by train for four or five hours from the town where I had grown up,

units.source_text: 那裡有一處東北地區少有的溫暖海濱溫泉，

en.t: there was a warm seaside hot spring resort, rare for the Tohoku region,

units.source_text: 村頭有五間大小的老房子，牆壁斑駁，

en.t: at the edge of the village stood an old house of about five rooms, with mottled, peeling walls,

units.source_text: 房屋的竹子上滿是蟲蛀，幾乎到了無法修繕的程度。

en.t: and the bamboo in the house was riddled with insect damage, almost beyond repair.
